name: nested-sections-coverage-reconcile
body:
SPEC RECONCILIATION (nested-sections; feedback-18, feedback-20) [with user].

SOURCE / INCONSISTENCY: `apg plan verify nested-sections` blocks — derived solution coverage demands that every code unit `implemented-by` a solution node reached by the plan's requirements be touched by a plan task. The plan's requirements reach solution components cli-commands, template-registry, deck-page, renderer, slide-parser and agent-guide. Five anchors were untouched and the feature genuinely does not change them: (1) agent-guide -> internal/scaffold.DefaultThemeCSS; (2) cli-commands -> cli.Run / runInit / runInitLibrary; (3) renderer -> internal/render.RenderDeck; (4) deck-page -> internal/assets/pages/deck.html.tmpl; (5) template-registry -> internal/template.NewRegistryFromLibrary. Newer plan tasks already cover the genuinely-changed units (renderer.RenderSlide/parseLayouts/slideData/renderSection/itemContext; template.NewRegistry/checkDeclaredName; scaffold.Init/InitLibrary/InitExternal/writeHelloSeed; cli.printTemplateSections; slide-parser exempt; gallery).

EDITS (each edge change and why):
1. agent-guide: REMOVED implemented-by solution.component.agent-guide -> go.../internal/scaffold.DefaultThemeCSS. Confirmed inaccurate — a theme stylesheet is not agent-guide content (feedback-18); its real units (Init, InitExternal, InitLibrary, writeHelloSeed) are all tasked by phase-03 tasks 23-26. Body updated to drop DefaultThemeCSS.
2. cli-commands: did NOT delete its true anchors. ADDED solution.component.cli-templates (contains: solution.container.cli-binary) with implemented-by -> go.../internal/cli.printTemplateSections (the unit the template-listing requirements actually reach; phase-04 task-1). Re-pointed realised-by domain.service.template-registry from solution.component.cli-commands to solution.component.cli-templates (ADDED, REMOVED). cli-commands (cli.Run/runInit/runInitLibrary) is now reached only by the init/init-library/serve services, none driven by this plan's requirements, so its true implemented-by anchors are preserved.
3. renderer: split by role. solution.component.renderer is the section renderer — REMOVED implemented-by -> internal/render.RenderDeck; ADDED implemented-by -> internal/render.renderer.renderSection and -> internal/render.itemContext (both phase-03 tasked), keeping RenderSlide/parseLayouts/slideData. ADDED solution.component.deck-renderer (contains: cli-binary) with implemented-by -> internal/render.RenderDeck. ADDED domain.service.render-sections (realised-by solution.component.renderer) and moved the four requirements' render path: ADDED drives item-context/section-template-context/template-context/template-language -> domain.service.render-sections; REMOVED the same four drives -> domain.service.render-deck. Re-pointed realised-by domain.service.render-deck from solution.component.renderer to solution.component.deck-renderer (ADDED, REMOVED; deck-page kept). domain.service.render-deck now upstreams only pdf-via-print/slide-metadata (not this plan's requirements), so deck-renderer and deck-page are not plan-reached, while renderer's section units are. Renderer body updated to point deck-level assembly at deck-renderer.
4. deck-page: NO edge deleted. deck.html.tmpl is untouched; after (3) deck-page is reached only via domain.entity.deck-rebuilt and the whole-deck render path, neither of which this plan's requirements drive.
5. template-registry: RE-ANCHORED implemented-by -> go.../internal/template.NewRegistryFromLibrary from solution.component.template-registry to solution.component.template-library-loader (the loader service builds the registries from the library's files, per domain.service.load-template-library); template-library-loader is not plan-reached. template-registry is left with NewRegistry and checkDeclaredName, both tasked by phase-01 tasks 11-12.
6. Body updates: solution.component.agent-guide (dropped DefaultThemeCSS) and solution.component.renderer (deck assembly -> deck-renderer).

SELF-REVIEW: every plan requirement still reaches a solution node; no requirement lost its only drives edge; every reached component's implemented-by anchors are covered by plan tasks (template-registry: NewRegistry/checkDeclaredName; cli-templates: printTemplateSections; renderer: RenderSlide/parseLayouts/slideData/renderSection/itemContext; agent-guide: Init/InitExternal/InitLibrary/writeHelloSeed; slide-parser: no anchors); no dangling endpoints.

RESERVATIONS FOR THE HUMAN GATE:
- The four drive moves off domain.service.render-deck narrow those requirements' whole-deck render trace to the section renderer. template-context and template-language in particular include deck-level context/layout, whose unchanged RenderDeck realisation is no longer on their spine. This was the minimal way to keep RenderDeck's true implemented-by without a no-change plan task; if deck-level trace is wanted, a plan task or a different mechanism is needed.
- Adding cli-templates and deck-renderer refines the component decomposition for coverage. The broad cli-commands and renderer bodies still describe their full scope; the new components scope only the feature-reached units.
- No requirement or constraint text was changed.
